executiveSummary.headline: Strengthen Hotel-Specific Visibility Through Better Information Control
executiveSummary.lead: Waterstone Resort & Marina has broad scenario coverage, but its portfolio position and uneven recognition of waterfront, dining and event attributes indicate room for tighter information control. The plan prioritizes verified property facts first, then selective commercial tests.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: Metrics describe presence in monitored AI answers—not booking conversion, traveler exposure or revenue impact.

themes.title: Measured AI Presence
themes.what: 53.5% AI consideration and 76.6% scenario presence; #5 of 6 in the defined relevant portfolio set.
themes.whyItMatters: These are certified presence measures, not booking conversion or revenue attribution.

themes.title: Accuracy and Information Control
themes.what: ADP measured 53.5% AI consideration and 76.6% scenario presence. Panoramic views were recognized in 9.9% of tested observations; ballroom in 11.7%; on-site restaurant, Lake Boca Raton setting and Curio Collection affiliation were not recognized in the tested set.
themes.whyItMatters: Validate hotel facts first, then align official and partner content around a controlled source of truth.

themes.title: Technical and Commercial Follow-Through
themes.what: The zero-cost automated probe returned network-level fetch failures (status 0) for homepage, robots.txt and sitemap on 2026-11-05. This does not establish a public outage or crawler block.
themes.whyItMatters: Investigate technical signals cautiously and pursue commercial content only after a hotel go/no-go decision.

actions.headline: Repeat Technical Accessibility Checks From Approved Environments
actions.priorityWhy: The probe failed at the network layer and produced no HTTP response, so no accessibility conclusion is supportable.
actions.whatWeFound: Homepage, robots.txt and sitemap fetches returned status 0 with 'fetch failed'.
actions.whyItMatters: A controlled retest is needed before attributing the result to the hotel site, hosting provider or research environment.
recommendedSteps: Retest from hotel/agency monitoring and a separate approved external environment.
Record DNS, TLS and HTTP outcomes.
Retrieve robots.txt and sitemap if available.
Escalate only if the failure reproduces.

methodology.scope: Reuses the certified local ADP baseline and action brief with a bounded zero-cost technical probe. No paid research, Airtable write, ADP remeasurement or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — confirmed by certified ADP measurement or directly observed evidence.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — requires hotel, agency or platform review before change.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand and approves the facts.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership validates facts, commercial priorities and public changes.
Agency or platform teams investigate access and implement only approved work.
Dealality packages existing measurement context and evidence; it does not imply revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked later. Completion alone does not prove AI or revenue change.
methodology.nextStep: Confirm the decision items, then authorize the highest-priority validated work.
